room.decisions.title: Decision register
room.decisions.text: What the war room decided, each with a D-number, an owner, a target date and time, optional approvers and what it applies to. Responders and leads propose decisions, record a call already made as approved, or register a /decision chat message; the outcome and the implementation show in the stream. Guests read the register.

items.name: Pending
items.text: Proposed and waiting for its approvers, or for a lead or the owner when it has none.

items.name: Approved
items.text: Every approver approved (without approvers, a lead or the owner did). Can be marked implemented, superseded, or cited by an asset flag or a vulnerability finding.

items.name: Superseded
items.text: A later decision that replaces it was approved.

decision.approvers.title: Approvers
decision.approvers.text: Room members who must approve the decision: it is approved once every one of them approves, and rejected as soon as one rejects. With no approver, a lead or the owner approves or rejects it. Approvers are fixed once the decision is decided.

decision.status.title: Status when proposing
decision.status.text: Pending puts the decision to its approvers - or, when it has none, to a lead or its owner. Approved records a call already made: it is offered only without approvers, and only a lead or the decision's owner can record it.

decision.applies_to.title: Applies to
decision.applies_to.text: The whole war room, or chosen cases and assets of the attached cases. An asset flag that requires a decision, or a vulnerability finding, can cite an approved decision that applies to the room, to the asset's case or to the asset. A case you cannot open shows as restricted.

decision.target.title: Target
decision.target.text: When the decision should be carried out (UTC). An open decision - proposed, or approved and not implemented - past its target shows as overdue and on the Board.

decision.implementation.title: Implementation
decision.implementation.text: A lead or the owner marks an approved decision implemented (and can reopen it). An implemented decision is no longer open.

room.board.title: Board
room.board.text: The war room at a glance: a row of indicator tiles (compromised assets, open decisions, exceptions, open tasks, flags, open vulnerabilities and more), then panels: one card per attached case, open decisions, what needs attention and open tasks. Needs attention lists what nobody has triaged yet. Figures cover the attached cases you can open and refresh every minute; a tile opens the matching tab, filtered. A lead sets the widgets for everyone (Edit board); anyone can hide, reorder or move them just for themselves (Customize, kept in this browser).

room.scope.title: Scope
room.scope.text: Every asset of the cases attached to this war room that you can open, with its compromise status, its flags and its open vulnerability findings. Filter by case, flag, compromise or findings, or search by name, IP, domain or type. The Board's tiles and flag legend open this tab already filtered. Cases you cannot open are only counted. Guests do not get this tab.
